item.title: Invention of DNA "Page Numbers" Opens Up Possibilities for the Bioeconomy
item.description:
📝 Caltech researchers have invented a new technology to write long sequences of DNA with groundbreaking accuracy. But in order to create entire genes, and thus enable biotechnologies such as personalized cancer vaccines, these short oligos would need to be stitched together with perfect accuracy into longer, complex DNA sequences. Enter Kaihang Wang's Sidewinder.
🔗 Read more: https://www.caltech.edu/about/news/invention-dna-page-numbers-synthesis-kaihang-wang
